title: Base change of universal homeomorphisms
statement:
Base changes of universal homeomorphisms
[def-weil-universal-homeomorphism] are universal homeomorphisms.

mathlib_searches.query: a morphism property defined to hold for every base change is stable under base change
mathlib_searches.verdict: match: the universally construction is the node's quantified definition
match: specializes with P = topologically IsHomeomorph

mathlib_searches.results: Limits.lean:872 defines P.universally by every pullback of f satisfying P; :889-891 gives universally_isStableUnderBaseChange; Constructors.lean:259-262 defines topologically IsHomeomorph as the underlying-map property

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: instantiate P with AlgebraicGeometry.topologically IsHomeomorph (Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Morphisms/Constructors.lean:259-262). By the definition of universally (Mathlib/CategoryTheory/MorphismProperty/Limits.lean:872-873), P.universally is exactly the node's quantified notion of a universal homeomorphism; the instance at lines 889-891 says every base change again has that property. No use is made of the distinct slopmaster2 IsUniversalHomeomorphism class.

split_report.summary: The quantified universal-homeomorphism property is a direct instance of Mathlib's universally construction, and universally_isStableUnderBaseChange proves stability under arbitrary base change. The imported agent proof is therefore replaced by an exact Mathlib leaf.
split_report.blueprint: The sole sentence of the blueprint node's proof, 'If v is a base change of u, then every base change of v is ... also a base change of u,' is the general pullback pasting argument in Mathlib's universally_isStableUnderBaseChange at Limits.lean:889-891.
